question: Can low-FPR ranking using measured modal-pair stability coordinates improve near-flutter warning misses without modifying the frozen continuous margin predictor?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs,4454 clips,five fixed design folds,seed42,all37 existing acquisition conditions. No TCN,GRU,new member network,reserved-split scoring,production cutover or outcome-based tuning.
data: Reuse the provenance-verified15 design-cross-fitted107/174 shards and outer frozen predictors from stability_correction_20261003. TRAIN four unchanged equal-weight views. Scale on proper-TRAIN OOF rows only; all acquisition copies stay with their design. Ignore physical-prior/oracle outputs.
readout: Unsafe-oriented score = -frozen_blend_margin/0.01 + standardized_features dot coefficients. Seven established control columns alone or plus21 symmetric products/Hurwitz coordinates. No intercept: ranking invariant to shifts. Preserve all five frozen point/interval fields exactly. The replacement column is an uncalibrated warning_score, not a probability.
objective: Mean squared pairwise hinge max(0,1+stable_score-unstable_score)^2 comparing each unsafe proper-TRAIN copy with the top ceil(0.05*stable_count) stable scores, plus0.05 coefficient-square sum. Unsafe objective cohort -0.05<true margin<=0; all true margin>0 stable rows compete for the low-FPR tail. Exact top5% negative empirical partial-AUC surrogate; no outer-derived weights/cohorts. Same objective and regularization for all three readouts.
optimizer: L-BFGS-B,zero correction initialization,maxiter2000,maxfun20000,ftol1e-12,gtol1e-7. Analytic objective gradient checked off ranking ties. Preserve optimizer failures; no substitute optimizer or outcome-based sweep.
calibration: Disjoint original outer calibration designs/four views; same existing order-statistic threshold method at1/5/10/20% stable calibration budgets. Thresholds computed from warning_score, never held data. Margins and intervals unchanged; no probability calibration claim.
primary: Near-unstable -0.01<margin<0 warning misses at nominal5% stable calibration budget; strict point-error optimism>0.03 remains a co-primary but must remain exactly unchanged. Report1% budget and stable-side optimism, all four budgets, actual held false warnings, and per-fold stability.
controls: Compare every rank readout against frozen and rank_control; rank_hurwitz versus rank_products. Physical-specific gain requires matched-product comparison, not only frozen improvement.
guardrails: Held stable false warnings, near-stable warning frequency, unchanged point/interval predictions, all existing accuracy/pessimism metrics. A lower miss rate bought by more held false warnings is a tradeoff, not dominance.
verification: Finite-difference gradient smoke, optimizer success, exact frozen fields and thresholds, archived OOF/control provenance replay, all calibration budgets, saved-head reload and actual15 raw-waveform acquisitions. No permanent product tests needed for an exploratory artifact.
uncertainty: 2000 fixed-prediction paired whole-design bootstrap draws; average acquisition views before resampling. One model seed, repeated TRAIN exploration, no refit uncertainty or multiplicity correction; calibration budgets are not held/population guarantees. No automated adoption.
